claim_traces.claim_title: Great Wall of China visible from space
claim_traces.claim_text: "The Great Wall of China is the only man-made structure visible from space with the naked eye."
reasoning_steps: The claim that the Great Wall of China is the only man-made structure visible from space with the naked eye is a well-documented misconception

NASA and astronauts, including China's first astronaut Yang Liwei, have confirmed that the Great Wall is virtually impossible to see from low Earth orbit without telescopic aid, largely because it is only a few meters wide and made of materials that blend into the surrounding landscape
Furthermore, many other man-made structures—such as highways, large dams, airports, bridges, and illuminated cities at night—can be seen from low Earth orbit with the unaided eye.
